basic_info.description: Spacious, light-filled, top-floor flat with private garage, one block to Alamo Square! Move right in to this stunning condo and have all top city amenities within minutes from your door! 3 bedrooms, formal dining room with preserved Victorian details, city outlooks, in-unit laundry, shared yard and an extra large private garage and storage make this a one-of-a-kind opportunity. Boutique building with low HOA. Between Hayes Valley and NOPA, stroll to Divisadero corridor and enjoy mornings at The Mill, dinners at NOPA and shopping at Bi-Rite! This is a special property not to miss!
